original_data_policy: Preserve all previous protocols, counts, intervals and manifests. This is a new analysis, not original preregistration.

h1_audit.cases: all 25 original T03 cells, 20 independent seed blocks per cell
h1_audit.selection: No method selected by whether an interval contains the estimate or favors H1.

coverage.reference: all 256 initial sign configurations; numerical integration checked at 12 vs 24 substeps
coverage.validation_scope: finite-population experiments at N4 only; do not transfer coverage to N8/12/16

h1_controlled.initial_state: domain: first N/2 flavor zero, remaining flavor one
h1_controlled.distribution: enumeration of all 4**N PSA initial states; no Monte Carlo CI for this deterministic quadrature
h1_controlled.primary_trend: OLS slope of R3 vs log10(mu), separately for each N; propagate observed integration sensitivity; report all adjacent differences
secondary: C3=0 baseline whose normalized RMSE is 1
h1_controlled.scope: finite controlled grid, not global hypothesis confirmation; time window differs from original T03 end=10

h2.circuit: archived N4 IBM base QPY plus captured Runtime Samplex template; 32 new local twirls seed 920000
h2.model: independent depolarizing on native SX/X and CZ; symmetric independent readout; mechanism study, not a fit to IBM
h2.refinement: 3 bisections of every initial adjacent expected absolute-error crossing of margin 0.01, independently for raw/mitigated and family; no extension beyond initial range
h2.primary_success: CI95 of circuit-minus-continuous-exact lies entirely within [-0.01,0.01]; add PSA/reference numerical bound when relevant, keep Trotter bias as part of actual error
h2.secondary_success: CI95 upper bound of absolute-error difference against PSA and against C3=0 both below zero; separate from primary equivalence
h2.threshold: first loss of success from zero along the ordered grid; report bracket, open bound or failure already at zero; do not treat isolated reentry as a monotone threshold
h2.power: empirical probability of the primary equivalence decision under repeated independent finite-shot campaigns; uncertainty interval and pointwise scope
h2.interpretation: exploratory characterization of fixed noise families; no global superiority or automatic hardware submission

hardware.points: retain the previously selected physical pilot points and QPYs; no selection from new confirmation data
hardware.order: alternate N6/N8 PUB order by block; both circuits per job
hardware.analysis: independent job-block bootstrap, no second multinomial resampling; preserve each full bitstring; no PSA/hardware artificial seed pairing
hardware.comparisons: absolute error vs deterministic full-support PSA and vs C3=0, for each size
hardware.multiplicity: four two-sided intervals at level 0.9875 (Bonferroni family alpha=0.05); success requires all four upper error-difference bounds below zero
hardware.equivalence: report separately; N8 two-step ideal error exceeds 0.01, so this design does not promise equivalence to exact
hardware.gate: before submitting, validate target support, archived QPY hashes, two PUBs/job, shot/options caps and fresh calibration; if unsupported stop instead of expanding jobs
hardware.scope: confirmation of lower error at two fixed points; not controlled N scaling or computational quantum advantage
